title: Admin Super Admin panel and overview chart fix
summary: Administrators get a clearer day-to-day Admin panel, while Cloudron super-admins gain a dedicated Super Admin area for technical controls. Overview charts no longer grow endlessly down the page.
changes: Added a Super Admin panel and sidebar entry for Cloudron myapes.superadmin members, covering directory groups, roles, permissions, modules, maintenance, and technical analytics.
Simplified the Admin overview and user management for ordinary administrators.
Labeled Cloudron MyAPES versus other Cloudron directory groups, and protected versus custom role mappings.
Made roles and permissions easier to read with plain-language titles, descriptions, and grouped catalogues.
Showed module manage controls open by default instead of collapsed disclosures.
Fixed Chart.js overview canvases so fixed-height wrappers stop infinite page growth and broken chart imagery.
Enabled the Local QA role switcher to sign into the seeded Super Admin account for local Super Admin panel testing.
Tidied the Local QA role switcher layout so four roles and the environment label stay readable without overlap.
version_rationale: A backward-compatible minor release introducing the Super Admin panel capability and clearer admin authorization boundaries, plus a chart rendering fix.
validation: PHPUnit coverage for admin access, Super Admin routes, authorization gates, modules, maintenance, roles, and analytics dashboards; Aikido scan on key changed files; myapes:changelog-validate against origin/main.
known_limitations: Custom app-owned groups are not introduced; groups remain Cloudron directory catalogue entries with optional custom role mappings.
Existing /admin technical URLs remain at the same paths and are now Super Admin–gated rather than relocated under /superadmin except for the new overview.
rollback: Revert this release record, VERSION, runtime manifest version, Super Admin views and routes, authorization matrix updates, admin UI Blade/CSS/JS changes, and related feature assertions. Re-run authorization metadata synchronization after rollback so protected role permissions match the restored matrix. No database schema rollback is required beyond restoring permission seed expectations.
provenance: Defined by the Admin UX cleanup with Super Admin technical panel for MyAPES Account issue #76 and pull request #77.
